thread:
anika: Drafting a PR to update Polarion4B model entry — clarifying supported variants, token limits, and small SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712
sam: Thanks. Can you paste the bench numbers used? unsure which throughput numbers to reference.
anika: Nightly perf run (nvme cluster): p50 28ms/token for 1-token step, p95 110ms for 512 context (per-request end-to-end). Throughput: ~450 tokens/sec on g4dn-like instance for quantized variant.
kevin: We should call out that the lowmem-quant variant disables KV cache past 2048 tokens — call out fallback to streaming fallback.
marcus: Also add a short note about embeddings vs generation: polarion-4b/embed is supported but only single-chunk embed (no sharding). Add example.
anika: Adding both notes. Here's proposed SDK snippets to include:

```python
# python snippet
client.generate(model="polarion-4b", input="summarize...", max_tokens=256)
client.embed(model="polarion-4b-embed", input=["a doc"])
```

```js
// js snippet
await client.generate({ model: 'polarion-4b', prompt: 'TL;DR', max_tokens: 128 })
await client.embed({ model: 'polarion-4b-embed', input: ['a doc'] })
```

sam: Looks fine. For the embed note, can we add a warning about chunking >512kb per doc? People keep hitting that.
kevin: Also include small benchmark table link to the perf-run gist instead of inlining numbers: https://gist.github.com/redwood/perf-polarion-2026
docs-bot: lint-check failed — missing markdown anchor for "compatibility-quirks" in model-catalog/polarion4b.md
marcus: I can fix the anchor and add the embed warning. Will submit a tiny PR against your branch @anika.
anika: awesome — please also add a one-sentence mention about deduping model variants in the catalog list (we had duplicate 'polarion-4b-quant' label).
sam: i'll review the PR later today and check the perf link + unit test for doc build
anika: thanks all. I'll open the PR now with changes and assign @sam @marcus for review. Will add eng-ml eyeballs for the KV-cache note.
